name: friendster-modern
description: A modern, full-stack social media platform built with TypeScript

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && npm run lint && cd ../web && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && npm run typecheck && cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit
